notes.title: Winter Sale!
notes.notes:
Happy holidays! 

From 19 Dec to 2nd Jan (10am PST), Little Ghosthunter will be on sale at a 20% discount!

Little Ghosthunter was created with sunshine, greenery, and relaxation in mind. But don't forget, there's also a time for winter. The trees and the animals are going to sleep, and everything's getting a little bit quieter. Now it's your turn to slow down, breathe, and listen.

notes.title: Game Launches on 23rd October!
notes.notes:
Little Ghosthunter is launching on the eve of the next half moon, that is, [b]23rd October 2024[/b]. You can get it for [b]15% off[/b] for the first seven days, so make sure you don't miss it!

[previewyoutube=XOHgRbdpqF0;full][/previewyoutube]

The demo has been updated to align with the full game. Make sure you've wishlisted the game so you get notified when it is released. Until then, sit tight! Ghost season is coming soon :)

notes.title: Update Notes for Demo v1.0.1
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removing an item no longer messes up the sheet music inventory icon.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the player to freeze when interacting with objects after the first photo flashback.
[*] Added more sounds.
[*] Exorcised the ghost on the stairs.
[*] Shifted the interaction range slightly more behind the player.
[/list]
